support.notes: Draft profile. The Windows product supports RC001 voice and basic buttons, but the profile identity is not reconciled with upstream ARN9 yet; it must not be used for runtime matching until the GATT Model Number and HID identity are verified.

transports.notes: The Windows product uses ATVV voice for this model. The exact capability variant still needs profile-level verification.
Basic buttons work on Windows, but the HID VID/PID and the relation to upstream ARN9 are not yet confirmed.

protocols.notes: ATVV is used by the Windows product; model-specific capability details are pending profile verification.

platforms.notes: Upstream tracks the ordinary model as ARN9. The RC001/ARN9 relationship must be verified before claiming macOS support under this ID.
Basic voice and button support exists in the migrated Windows implementation; this profile is not yet a runtime source of truth.
No Linux adapter has been implemented.

notes: The current Rust function remote_model_from_model_number maps ARN9 to Rc003; that conflicts with the upstream ARN9 profile. Resolve this before promoting the profile to implemented.
